title: Packet

---

Packet is an **in-beta**, experimental add-on to Minecraft, made by Aswd_LV. It is inspired by the _Essential mod_.

This mod is meant to modernize the Minecraft UI, with a few extra QoL features planned *in the future*.

## Current features:
Improved Main menu, pause menu, singleplayer and multiplayer select menus, options menu, and a few extra menus

Player info + list directly in pause menu



## Roadmap planned for Packet:

### Now (June 2026):
UI refresh

small QoL improvements

beta testing

### Q3 2026 (most likely September):
Bug fixing

QoL features

UI for server moderators

Hopefully out of beta and v1.0 release

### Q4 2026:
More bug fixing

more QoL features

peer-to-peer features, if possible/feasible (eg. multiplayer worlds with your Microsoft/Xbox friends)


---

The mod, currently, is in beta. For the time being, it is *All Rights Reserved* with plans to opensource it under GPLv3.
